title: Challenge 25: Read and write structured JSON files
prompt: Write a Swift snippet for “Read and write structured JSON files” and include the required source evidence: let , print(. Then compile/run it locally and check one edge case. This challenge is part of the practical-exercise list in the Swift curriculum PDF.
objective: Encode a typed model into JSON, decode it back, and test a missing or malformed field.
target_skills: Read and write structured JSON files
expected_output: A working or reviewable Swift solution with tests or written evidence for the stated acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Implement the requested behavior for read and write structured json files.
Cover at least one boundary case or failure path.
Run with an appropriate local Swift toolchain or provide a short human-review note when target-specific.
hints: Decompose the task into a model, a small function and a verification step.
Use the closest relevant lesson and official reference rather than guessing API availability.
Test one normal case and one boundary/failure case.
grading_method: Minimum source evidence check plus the acceptance criteria; compile and run locally before considering the challenge complete.
retry_policy: Allow retries. Incorrect submissions award no XP; backend-only idempotency controls rewards.
status_note: Protected reference solution; challenge remains unpublished until expert review.
